lim_todo_min.translation: Press - until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.

lim_todo_max.english: Press + until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.
lim_todo_max.translation: Press + until the surface binds, back off one step, then Set. Next skips this side.

lim_flap.english: These are the flap end points: Max is full flap. The wizard sets the flap travel to land on them.
lim_flap.translation: These are the flap end points: Max is full flap. The wizard sets the flap travel to land on them.

lim_done.english: Every surface has its limits. A side you skipped keeps its old limit.
lim_done.translation: Every surface has its limits. A side you skipped keeps its old limit.

thr_intro.english: Set how far each surface moves at full stick, using the throws from your model's guide. The wizard puts the model in PASSTHROUGH mode, so your sticks move the surfaces directly. Have a throw meter or ruler ready.
thr_intro.translation: Set how far each surface moves at full stick, using the throws from your model's guide. The wizard puts the model in PASSTHROUGH mode, so your sticks move the surfaces directly. Have a throw meter or ruler ready.

thr_axis_fmt.english: Hold %s and measure a surface. Press - or + until it reaches the throw you want, then check the other way. Throw: %d%%.
thr_axis_fmt.translation: Hold %s and measure a surface. Press - or + until it reaches the throw you want, then check the other way. Throw: %d%%.

thr_fine_intro.english: Fine-tune one surface in one direction, for differential or a surface that differs from its pair.
thr_fine_intro.translation: Fine-tune one surface in one direction, for differential or a surface that differs from its pair.

thr_at_limit_fmt.english: Servo %s reaches its binding limit before full stick. Lower the throw, or allow more travel in Binding limits.
thr_at_limit_fmt.translation: Servo %s reaches its binding limit before full stick. Lower the throw, or allow more travel in Binding limits.

thr_side_limit.english: Full stick reaches the binding limit on this side.
thr_side_limit.translation: Full stick reaches the binding limit on this side.

thr_no_passthrough.english: PASSTHROUGH mode isn't on: check your radio is on.
thr_no_passthrough.translation: PASSTHROUGH mode isn't on: check your radio is on.

thr_done.english: Throw is a percentage of the servo's normal travel. The stabilizer's output is a share of it, so set throws first and tune afterwards.
thr_done.translation: Throw is a percentage of the servo's normal travel. The stabilizer's output is a share of it, so set throws first and tune afterwards.

trv_intro.english: Full stick on every axis at once: the bar is how far each surface goes, the marks its limits, the dot where it is now. Above 100% it hits a limit first. Try the stick corners.
trv_intro.translation: Full stick on every axis at once: the bar is how far each surface goes, the marks its limits, the dot where it is now. Above 100% it hits a limit first. Try the stick corners.

trv_clipping.english: Some surfaces reach their limit. Lower the throw on the axes that share them, or accept it: full roll with full pitch on elevons is the usual case.
trv_clipping.translation: Some surfaces reach their limit. Lower the throw on the axes that share them, or accept it: full roll with full pitch on elevons is the usual case.

trv_ok.english: Every surface stays inside its limits.
trv_ok.translation: Every surface stays inside its limits.

gyr_intro.english: Now the stabilizer drives the surfaces. The wizard turns ANGLE mode on: tilt the model by hand and hold it, and the surfaces should push back toward level.
gyr_intro.translation: Now the stabilizer drives the surfaces. The wizard turns ANGLE mode on: tilt the model by hand and hold it, and the surfaces should push back toward level.

gyr_no_angle.english: ANGLE mode isn't on: the surfaces may only react while the model moves.
gyr_no_angle.translation: ANGLE mode isn't on: the surfaces may only react while the model moves.

gyr_roll.english: Roll the model so the right wing drops.
gyr_roll.translation: Roll the model so the right wing drops.

gyr_yaw.english: Swing the nose to the right.
gyr_yaw.translation: Swing the nose to the right.

gyr_wrong.english: If the surfaces were right in the Direction step but wrong here, the board orientation doesn't match how the board is mounted. Run the Sensors step again; don't reverse servos for this.
gyr_wrong.translation: If the surfaces were right in the Direction step but wrong here, the board orientation doesn't match how the board is mounted. Run the Sensors step again; don't reverse servos for this.

gyr_done.english: The stabilizer pushes the right way on every axis.
gyr_done.translation: The stabilizer pushes the right way on every axis.

tg_intro.english: Two things you'll want in the air on the first flights: a way to trim, and a knob to turn the stabilizer gain up or down.
tg_intro.translation: Two things you'll want in the air on the first flights: a way to trim, and a knob to turn the stabilizer gain up or down.

tg_trim_q.english: How do you want to trim?
tg_trim_q.translation: How do you want to trim?

tg_how_buttons.english: On the radio: in Trims keep the aileron, elevator and rudder trims. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add a free mix TRIM: always on, source Maximum, Add, output a spare channel, with an action per trim button at these weights: T1 Left 70, T1 Right 80, T2 Up 60, T2 Down 50, T4 Left 30, T4 Right 40. Then press Detect and press any trim button.
tg_how_buttons.translation: On the radio: in Trims keep the aileron, elevator and rudder trims. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add a free mix TRIM: always on, source Maximum, Add, output a spare channel, with an action per trim button at these weights: T1 Left 70, T1 Right 80, T2 Up 60, T2 Down 50, T4 Left 30, T4 Right 40. Then press Detect and press any trim button.

tg_how_channels.english: On the radio: set the aileron, elevator and rudder trims to Coarse. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add free mixes ROLL TRIM, PITCH TRIM and YAW TRIM: always on, source that trim, Add, 100%, each on its own spare channel. Then press Detect and press each trim when asked.
tg_how_channels.translation: On the radio: set the aileron, elevator and rudder trims to Coarse. In those three mixes turn Trim off. Add free mixes ROLL TRIM, PITCH TRIM and YAW TRIM: always on, source that trim, Add, 100%, each on its own spare channel. Then press Detect and press each trim when asked.

tg_auto_note.english: Use Auto trim: give it a switch in Mode switches. Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm.
tg_auto_note.translation: Use Auto trim: give it a switch in Mode switches. Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm.

tg_turn_knob.english: Turn the knob or slider end to end...
tg_turn_knob.translation: Turn the knob or slider end to end...

tg_turn_axis_knob_fmt.english: Turn the %s gain knob end to end...
tg_turn_axis_knob_fmt.translation: Turn the %s gain knob end to end...

tg_buttons_check.english: Press each trim button: its name shows below. If one doesn't, check its weight in the TRIM mix.
tg_buttons_check.translation: Press each trim button: its name shows below. If one doesn't, check its weight in the TRIM mix.

tg_button_none_fmt.english: No trim button pressed (AUX %d reads %d us).
tg_button_none_fmt.translation: No trim button pressed (AUX %d reads %d us).

tg_gain_q.english: A knob or slider to turn the stabilizer up or down in flight: fully down is off, center 75%, fully up 150%.
tg_gain_q.translation: A knob or slider to turn the stabilizer up or down in flight: fully down is off, center 75%, fully up 150%.

tg_gain_centre.english: Fly the first flight with it at center.
tg_gain_centre.translation: Fly the first flight with it at center.

tg_full.english: Every adjustment slot is in use. Free one on the Adjustments page.
tg_full.translation: Every adjustment slot is in use. Free one on the Adjustments page.

mod_intro.english: Put modes on switches: press Assign, then flick the switch to the position that turns the mode on. Only ARM is required; you can change modes later on the Modes page.
mod_intro.translation: Put modes on switches: press Assign, then flick the switch to the position that turns the mode on. Only ARM is required; you can change modes later on the Modes page.

mod_arm_missing.english: ARM isn't on a switch yet: without it the model can't be armed.
mod_arm_missing.translation: ARM isn't on a switch yet: without it the model can't be armed.

mod_arm_on.english: The ARM switch is on. Switch it off before you carry on.
mod_arm_on.translation: The ARM switch is on. Switch it off before you carry on.

mod_flick.english: Flick the switch to the on position now...
mod_flick.translation: Flick the switch to the on position now...

mod_no_slot.english: Every mode slot is in use. Free one on the Modes page.
mod_no_slot.translation: Every mode slot is in use. Free one on the Modes page.

mod_help_arm.english: Arms the motor. Nothing else works without it.
mod_help_arm.translation: Arms the motor. Nothing else works without it.

mod_help_manual.english: Stabilization off, with your rates kept. A good bail-out.
mod_help_manual.translation: Stabilization off, with your rates kept. A good bail-out.

mod_help_att_hold.english: Let go of a stick and the model holds its attitude on that axis.
mod_help_att_hold.translation: Let go of a stick and the model holds its attitude on that axis.

mod_help_trainer.english: The stabilizer stops the model rolling or pitching past its limits.
mod_help_trainer.translation: The stabilizer stops the model rolling or pitching past its limits.

mod_help_auto_trim.english: Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm: the trim is saved.
mod_help_auto_trim.translation: Fly level with it on for a few seconds, then land and disarm: the trim is saved.

mod_help_passthrough.english: A bench tool, not a flight mode: sticks straight to the surfaces. Put it on a switch you won't hit in flight.
mod_help_passthrough.translation: A bench tool, not a flight mode: sticks straight to the surfaces. Put it on a switch you won't hit in flight.

sty_intro.english: Choose the style closest to how you fly. It sets how fast the model turns at full stick.
sty_intro.translation: Choose the style closest to how you fly. It sets how fast the model turns at full stick.

fin_intro.english: That's the setup done. Here is what the model has.
fin_intro.translation: That's the setup done. Here is what the model has.

fin_before.english: Before the first flight: fit the propeller, check the surfaces follow the sticks and push against movement with PASSTHROUGH off, and do a range check.
fin_before.translation: Before the first flight: fit the propeller, check the surfaces follow the sticks and push against movement with PASSTHROUGH off, and do a range check.

msg_select_battery.english: Please select the battery you want to use:
msg_select_battery.translation: 请选择您要使用的电池：

write_failed.english: Battery profile could not be saved.
write_failed.translation: Battery 配置文件无法保存。

startup_no_link_detail.english: Power model and wait for telemetry.

reset_flight_ask_text.english: Are you sure you want to reset the flight?
reset_flight_ask_text.translation: 确定要重置飞行数据吗？
